results.goal: editing the message that carried the delta rolls the story back The check first waits for the group round J6.1 started to finish: a send returns before every member has replied, and an edit made mid-round is rolled back and then followed by the remaining replies' boundaries, which is a different scenario (L2 2026-09-23: J6.2 timed out on a still-generating round and J6.4 lost its notice to those boundaries).
deleting the last message leaves engine state consistent, not orphaned
the player is told the story stepped back after a mutation

results.prompt: After you edited and deleted messages, was it clear what the story did in response?
results.anchors: 1 = no idea, felt broken · 3 = worked it out from the drawer · 5 = the system said what it did
